authorization: Researcher prioritizes decoding phase transitions and correction thresholds in the continuing Lab 008 study.
question: Can a reduced exact automaton jointly carry the full-charge majority trie and every earlier-path availability predicate needed by the frozen shortest-then-lexicographic selector within the registered cap?
claim_boundary: This is a method-feasibility prerequisite for the W=5 selector second moment on a height-three strip. It cannot establish an all-width rate, midpoint noncorrectability, or a two-dimensional threshold.

frozen_interface.geometry: the exact height-three square strip, rough boundaries, measured interior charges and logical cut of the predecessor
frozen_interface.physical_law: p=1/2, q=1, full-charge fiber majority domain with the predecessor tie convention
frozen_interface.selector: shortest path first, then frozen lexicographic y/edge order
frozen_interface.target: exact physical-majority denominator and exact selector preimage second moment

alternatives: Build a reduced ordered decision diagram for earlier-path availability predicates and compose it with the full-charge majority trie.
Build a sequential ordered-path-pair dynamic program with exact dominance and infeasibility pruning.
If neither exact representation passes the controls, isolate an analytic embedded subfamily whose physical weight and target multiplicity give a valid one-sided lower bound.
planned_steps: Replay the exact W=3 and W=4 selector histograms, second moments and majority denominators before any W=5 evaluation.
Measure live/reduced state counts for both exact representations and reject any branch at the registered cap without extrapolation.
Evaluate W=5 only if one representation passes every replay, anti-merge and memory gate; otherwise name the minimal missing state interface.
acceptance_criteria: Exact W=3 and W=4 controls reproduce A=126,3926 and selector second moments 154,7968 without merging configurations that disagree on an earlier path.
Every reduction key states the retained charge prefix, frontier data, selected target relation and earlier-path availability predicates.
A W=5 second moment is reported only after both replay and anti-merge gates pass; otherwise the branch fails closed at its measured obstruction.
No two-width trend, fixed-width strip value, or method-feasibility result is promoted to a physical divergence or threshold claim.
stop_rule: Stop after the W=3/W=4 validation matrix and at most one gated W=5 exact evaluation. Do not enumerate the canonical L5 square, fit a rate or threshold, or exceed two million live states or 300 seconds.
decision: Both exact branches pass the W3/W4 replay and W5 cap gates. At W5, A=108978, S=336814, kappa=168407/54489 and maximum multiplicity 12; the exact reduced selector map has 179446 states and zero replay mismatches. This finite extensional compilation does not establish a width-recursive rate or threshold.
